Learn How It Works ↓
WHY OIL UNDERCOATING?
Protection that reaches the places rust begins.
Corrosion can begin in areas that are difficult to
inspect or clean. Oil-based rust protection is designed
to penetrate those vulnerable spaces.
Penetrating Protection
Creeping oil-based coatings can migrate into seams,
joints, welds, and enclosed areas that are difficult
to reach with conventional surface coatings.
Moisture Defense
Oil-based coatings help create a protective barrier
between metal and the moisture, salt, and oxygen
that contribute to corrosion.
Flexible Coverage
Unlike rigid coatings that may crack or trap
moisture if compromised, suitable oil-based
products remain flexible and can be reapplied
as part of routine vehicle maintenance.
BUILT FOR NEW ENGLAND
Winter roads are hard on exposed metal.
New Hampshire roads see snow, freezing temperatures,
road salt, and liquid deicing treatments. Salt-laden
moisture can collect around vehicle underbodies,
suspension components, seams, and cavities.
Regular inspections, cleaning, and appropriate
corrosion-protection treatments can help reduce
exposure and support long-term vehicle care.
Explore Our Approach ↗
ROAD SALT DEFENSE
DON'T WAIT FOR RUST TO SPREAD.
Prevention and regular maintenance matter,
especially when winter driving is unavoidable.
OUR APPROACH
Protection for the road ahead.
Oil-based and hybrid rustproofing products have
different characteristics. The appropriate treatment
depends on the vehicle, its condition, and the
manufacturer's application guidance.
Vehicle Assessment
Consider the vehicle's age, existing corrosion,
exposed components, and areas where moisture
and road debris accumulate.
Penetrating Oil Protection
Penetrating products are designed to reach
seams and cavities and help displace moisture
from vulnerable metal surfaces.
Hybrid Coating Options
Some rustproofing systems combine oil with wax
or lanolin to balance penetration, adhesion,
and protective film characteristics.
Ongoing Maintenance
Periodic inspection and reapplication, when
recommended for the chosen product, help
maintain coverage over time.
More
Product selection and treatment availability should be
confirmed before booking. This website does not claim
authorization or certification by NHOU.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Good questions. Straight answers.
How does oil undercoating work?
Oil-based undercoating creates a protective film
on suitable metal surfaces. Penetrating formulas
can creep into seams and cavities, helping
limit contact with moisture and road salt.
Can oil undercoating be applied to an older vehicle?
Some penetrating oil products are intended for
vehicles with existing surface corrosion.
Significant rust, structural deterioration,
and loose material should be assessed before
treatment. Undercoating does not repair damaged metal.
How often should undercoating be reapplied?
The appropriate interval depends on the product,
driving conditions, and vehicle condition.
Some oil-based systems recommend annual maintenance.
Always follow the specific product guidance.
Is oil undercoating the same as rubberized undercoating?
No. Oil-based coatings are generally designed
to remain flexible and penetrate vulnerable areas.
Rubberized coatings form a different type of film
and can require different preparation and maintenance.
Will undercoating eliminate rust permanently?
No corrosion-protection treatment can guarantee
that rust will never develop. Good coverage,
correct application, cleaning, and maintenance
can help reduce corrosion risk.
How do I schedule an appointment?
Use the Schedule Undercoating button to open
the Google Calendar appointment page and choose
an available time.
